definitions.recall@5: Mean, over answerable questions that have retrieval hits, of how many expected (doc_id, page) pairs appear in the first 5 hits. Null when no question has retrieval. An empty hit list scores 0. Citations are not treated as retrieval.
definitions.citation accuracy: Fraction of answerable questions whose answer cites at least one page and every cited (doc_id, page) is in the expected set. A refusal or an empty citation list scores 0 for that question.
definitions.refusal correctness: Fraction of unanswerable questions returned as a contract refusal (kind refusal, reason not_found_in_manual).
definitions.uncited-number count: Count of numeric tokens in answer text that do not appear in a citation snippet, summed across the run. The local counter does not understand units or pinouts. An UncitedNumberCounter replaces it.
definitions.latency p50 (ms): 50th percentile of per-question runner time in milliseconds. Linear index (n - 1) * 0.50.
definitions.latency p95 (ms): 95th percentile of per-question runner time in milliseconds. Linear index (n - 1) * 0.95.
